summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of queryset update behavior with multiple inheritance by modifying the query chain to include the proxy model if applicable. The changes are minimal and focused on resolving the reported bug.

issues.description: The patch introduces a conditional check for `proxy_for_model` which may not align with Django's convention of handling multiple inheritance. It could be more idiomatic to use a different approach to ensure consistency with the rest of the codebase.
